subject: [PATCH 3/3] fs/proc/task_mmu: account device-private PMDs as present in smaps

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Suggested auditing PMD level device private entries in general due to past issues.

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Agreed with the fix and acknowledged it, but questioned the naming convention of 'present' in smaps_pte_entry().

2026-11-11.patch_summary: This patch series addresses an issue where device-private PMDs are not accounted for in the smaps output, leading to incorrect PSS and private/shared accounting. The fix involves marking these PMDs as present in smaps_pte_entry(), ensuring that mapcounts are used for PSS and private/shared accounting.

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary: Reviewed the patch and agreed with the fix, noting that it matches smaps_pte_entry().
reviews.raw_body:
On 11 Nov 2026, at 6:38, Usama Arif wrote:

> Device-private PMDs represent mapped pages, but smaps_pmd_entry()
> passes present=false to smaps_account(). That treats them like migration
> entries: mapcounts are ignored, PSS is charged in full, and exclusive
> mappings are accounted as shared.
>
> Match smaps_pte_entry() and mark device-private PMDs as present so
> smaps_account() uses mapcounts for PSS and private/shared accounting.
>
> Fixes: a30b48bf1b24 ("mm/migrate_device: implement THP migration of zone device pages")
> Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
> Signed-off-by: Usama Arif <usama.arif@linux.dev>
> ---
>  fs/proc/task_mmu.c | 5 ++++-
>  1 file changed, 4 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)
>

Like what smaps_pte_entry() does.

Reviewed-by: Zi Yan <ziy@nvidia.com>


Best Regards,
Yan, Zi
